verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents Payment Links and invoices with payment links, plus multi-item subscription billing that implies product and price concepts. It also offers agent tooling that can read and write account resources and script API calls in a session: the AgentOS MCP, a CLI that exposes a broad slice of the API, a sandbox Developer MCP, and a contract-to-billing skill. However, no evidence shows a documented API flow where an agent creates a product, then a price, then a payment link. Missing for 10: explicit Product and Price API objects or endpoints, documentation that payment links can be created via API or CLI from a product/price, an end-to-end agent walkthrough of this flow, and hands-on corroboration.
